name: Shubham Tiwari
summary:
Results-driven Cybersecurity Analyst with 3+ years of experience in SOC operations, threat detection, incident response,
and data loss prevention (DLP). Hands-on expertise with CrowdStrike Falcon EDR, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Azure Sentinel,
and Forcepoint DLP. Proficient in MITRE ATT&CK threat modeling, SIEM log correlation, endpoint telemetry analysis, and
UEBA-based behavioral monitoring. Strong knowledge of BFSI compliance frameworks including ISO 27001, RBI
Guidelines, PCI-DSS, and NIST. Proven track record of reducing false positives, improving detection fidelity, and
maintaining zero SLA breaches in enterprise environments.
